_doc: Global flow registry (global_flow.py, run inside futures_state's hourly pass). Rows, never code: add a source here. adapter=none is a NAMED GAP with blocked_by. class: retail | institutional | dealer | central_bank | sovereign | etf | cross_border | forced. Every series is an exogenous_conditioner QUESTION for the judge, never a sized edge. avail_lag_days + avail_hour_utc stamp publication conservatively after the observation date. Named-gap rows and the already-live census ride the follow-up PR (#710) to keep this diff reviewable.

sources.why: SNB buys foreign currency by crediting banks' sight deposits: a weekly jump is the intervention footprint the franc price has not finished absorbing (SNB publishes Monday for the prior week).
GLD creations and redemptions are Western investment demand for physical gold; tonnes change against price separates investor flow from central-bank and Asian physical buying.

NSE splits every derivatives contract by owner: Indian retail (Client) is the largest options crowd on earth and trades against FII and prop desks. FII index-futures net leads INR flows; retail extremes are the contrarian leg.
Index options: dealer gamma/vanna sign decides whether hedging damps or amplifies moves (pin vs trend days); OI walls and max pain pull price into expiry; skew and put/call are the hedging crowd.
VIX options: the vol-of-vol crowd; call-heavy VIX OI is crash-hedging demand.
Gold and silver ETF options: dealer gamma, walls and skew in the metals' largest listed options market.
Oil and gas ETF options: retail-heavy energy options crowd and dealer hedging.
Treasury ETF options: duration hedging flow and the bond-crowd skew.
Currency ETF options: the only free listed FX skew and put/call (fills fx_options_risk_reversals, which has no free vendor source).
Country ETF options: US-listed hedging and speculation on China, EM, Japan, Brazil, Korea, India.

Japanese lifers, pensions and toshin buying foreign bonds sell yen; foreign buying of Japanese stocks buys it. MoF publishes the week on the following Thursday 08:50 JST (stamped later, conservatively).

_grid_doc: Every (player_class x region) cell with no live or gap row is UNSEARCHED; each hourly pass must turn at least one UNSEARCHED or gap cell into a live row (standing rule, zuck 2026-11-03: maximise every player's footprint everywhere).
